weaknesses.title: Chained *WHERE ops clobber each other's result specials
weaknesses.detail: MEDIANWHERE then FREQWHERE → FREQWHERE_TOTAL=0; reverse → median LAST_N=0. Dual-gate admit cannot compute p50+hist in one action without plate shuttle or re-query isolation.
weaknesses.repro: MEDIANWHERE; FREQWHERE → TOTAL 0; FREQWHERE; MEDIANWHERE → p50 0

weaknesses.title: LET bag = LAST loses bag type for TOPKEY/LOOKUPN
weaknesses.detail: SYS TOPKEY hbag after LET hbag=LAST from FREQWHERE → unknown form 'hbag'. Must TOPKEY FREQWHERE special directly.
weaknesses.repro: FREQWHERE; LET h=LAST; SYS TOPKEY h → unknown form

weaknesses.title: SYS EQS on LET-captured mode strings flaky in ARG boards
weaknesses.detail: LET mode_s=LAST after MODEWHERE then SYS EQS mode_s want_st → unknown form or false-neg in multi-action agent board; works in short proofs. Prefer LOOKUPN FREQWHERE want_st counts.
weaknesses.repro: MODEWHERE; LET m=LAST; SYS EQS m want → unknown form m

weaknesses.title: MODEWHERE ties → first-seen; empty → blank not soft miss
weaknesses.detail: ok+fail tie → first-seen ok. Empty env mode blank; admit must check N/TOTAL.
weaknesses.repro: mode canary with ok/fail; mode missing → blank

weaknesses.title: Empty MEDIANWHERE → 0 indistinguishable from true zero latency
weaknesses.detail: Need MEDIANWHERE_N; even-N uses lower mid.
